text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Sono-chan, Sono-chan... why don't we switch bodies for a while?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ソノちゃんソノちゃん、
これからちょっと入れ替わらない？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: No, that's too suspicious AND sudden. What are you up to this time?
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや
いきなりだな。
今度は何をたくらんでんの？

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: I found a hole that I really wanted to get into, but I'm afraid that your body would get stuck in it, Sono-chan, so... please, okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
思わず入りたくなる穴を見つけたんだけど、
ソノちゃんの体だと詰まっちゃいそうなんだよ～
だから
お願い、
ね？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: What's with that reason...? Well, it's true that I haven't had ale in a while. As long as you don't do anything dangerous, I don't mind.
text_block_list.orig_text:
どういう理由だよ……
ま、
私も
久々に麦しゅわやりたい気分だし。
危ないことしないならいいよ。

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Yay! I'm pretty sure that the Forbidden Elixir to change our bodies should be around here... Found it♪ Well then, Uncle, I'll leave it all up to you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やった～！
入れ替わりの秘薬は確かこの辺に……
みーっけ♪
それじゃおじちゃん、
よろしくっ！

text_block_list.name: Iroha Sono
text_block_list.text: OOOOOHHHHH~!
text_block_list.orig_text: わぁ～っ！

text_block_list.name: Child Iroha
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, it's been a while since Iroha's had her body back♪ One, two, three... Okay, everything's in order!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えへへっ、
久しぶりのイロハの体だっ♪
いちにっ、
さんしっ……
よしっ、
問題なーし！

text_block_list.name: Adult Sono
text_block_list.text: Welcome back, my out-of-shape body. Now then, where’d I leave my wallet?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おかえり、
私の不健康な体。
さてと、
財布はどこやったっけ。

text_block_list.name: Child Iroha
text_block_list.text: As for me, I'm off! That suspicious hole is waiting for Iroha!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃ行ってくるね！
穴がイロハを呼んでるぞーっ！

text_block_list.name: Adult Sono
text_block_list.text: Ahhhh, wait just a minute, Iroha. I'm not sure about letting you go alone, so have him go with y-... Huh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あー
ちょっと待ったイロハ。
一人で行かせるのは不安だし、
君もついてって
……って
あれ？

text_block_list.name: Child Iroha
text_block_list.text: Uwah, it's so bright outside! What's this? Something interesting is going to happen!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わぁっ、
外が
まぶしい！
なんだろこれ、
面白いこと起きそーっ！！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: On his way home from school, {0} saw some kids playing in the park.
text_block_list.orig_text:
学校からの帰り道、
{0}は
公園で遊ぶ子どもたちを見かけた。

text_block_list.name: Energetic Girl
text_block_list.text: Okay, then let's play "Three Colored Oni ( Tag )" next! Three teams should be perfect, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあ次は、
３色鬼やろっか！
チーム３つでちょうどだよね？

text_block_list.name: Busy boy
text_block_list.text: Ah, I think I have to go home now. I need to help out. Sorry, see you tomorrow!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
僕
手伝いあるからもう帰んないと。
ごめん、
また明日ね！

text_block_list.name: Energetic Girl
text_block_list.text: Bye-bye! But, what now? We can't split teams evenly like this. Hmm...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ばいばーい！
でも
どうしよう、
これだと
ピッタリ分けられないや。
うーん……

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Ah! Onii-chan over there! Come play with Iroha and the others!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
そこのおにーちゃん！
いろはたちと一緒に遊んでよ！

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Who's that? Iroha-chan, do you know him?
text_block_list.orig_text:
その人だーれ？
いろはちゃんの知り合い？

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: No, never seen him before! But he seems kind, so I thought he'd be okay.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ううん、
全然知らない人！
でも優しそうだから
大丈夫かなー
って。

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Well then, Nii-chan, why don't you join our team? If you team up with Isurugi your team'd be too strong and it'd be unfair.
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあ兄ちゃん、
こっちのチームに入ってよ。
石動と一緒だと、
強すぎてフコーヘーだし。

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, I guess that's true♪ Onii-chan hear up, if you let your guard down, Iroha will catch you in an instant.
text_block_list.orig_text:
えへへ、
それほどでもあるかなー♪
おにーちゃんも油断してたら、
いろはが一瞬で捕まえちゃうよっ。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Before he could reply, a game of tag began, and {0} joined in as he was told.
text_block_list.orig_text:
返事をする間もなく鬼ごっこが始まり、
{0}は言われるがままに参加した。

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Iroha's skills in tag are professional level! If you stand there daydreaming, she'll come to catch you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いろは、
鬼ごっこの腕はプロ級だからね！
ぼーっとしてたら
どんどん捕まえちゃうよーっ！

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Onii-chan, are you used to playing tag? Then maybe Iroha should get super serious!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おにーちゃん、
わりと鬼ごっことか慣れてる？
それじゃいろはも、
もーっと本気出しちゃおっかなー？

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: There's only Isurugi left in her team! Everyone, surround her!
text_block_list.orig_text:
石動のチームはあと一人だ！
みんなで囲めーっ！

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Heheh, Iroha still hasn't given up! A match isn't over until its over!
text_block_list.orig_text:
へへーん、
いろははまだまだ諦めないよ！
勝負は最後までわかんないしっ！

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Yay, Iroha wins!! Iroha's the ultimate tag champion!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やったー、
いろはの勝ちーっ！！
いろはが
鬼ごっこチャンピオンだーっ！

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Next up, let's play some jump rope♪ Onii-chan come and have a match with Iroha to see who jumps the most!
text_block_list.orig_text:
次はね、
縄跳びやろっか♪
おにーちゃん、
どっちがいっぱい跳べるか
いろはと勝負だよ！

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Next up... ball toss! Whoever drops it gets a penalty, so do your best, Onii-chan!
text_block_list.orig_text:
次はボール遊びだよ！
落としちゃった人が罰ゲームだから、
おにーちゃんも頑張ってね！

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Iroha's good at the horizontal bar too! Watch me, Onii-chan, I'll do something amazing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いろはね、
鉄棒だって得意なんだよ！
見ててねおにーちゃん、
すごいの決めちゃうから！

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: There it is! Iroha's triple backward somersault! As always, she's simply amazing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
出た～、
いろはちゃんの後方伸身３回宙返り！
いろはちゃんはやっぱりすごいね！

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Oh crap, it looks like Mom's back already! She sent me a message telling me to hurry up and come home.
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっべ、
母ちゃんもう帰ってきたっぽい！
早く帰ってこいって
メッセージ来てた。

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: I have to go home too. Iroha-chan, let's play again sometime.
text_block_list.orig_text:
わたしももう帰らなきゃ。
いろはちゃん、
また遊ぼうね。

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Okay, let's call it a day. Thanks, everyone. It was really fun♪ See you tomorrow~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わかった、
じゃあ
解散だね。
みんなありがと、
すっごい楽しかったよ♪
また明日ね～！

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: ...Now then, Onii-chan♪ What should we do next? We can play something you like if you want.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……さてと、
おにーちゃん♪
次は何やろっか？　
おにーちゃんの好きな遊びでいいよ。

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Hm? Iroha's still good to go, you know? She'll be fine, even if she's a little late...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？　
いろははまだ大丈夫だよ？
いろははしっかり者だから、
もう少し遅くても……

text_block_list.text: Iroha, I’m sorry! I couldn't get my work done in time so I ended up being late...
text_block_list.orig_text:
いろは、
ごめん！
仕事片付かなくって、
遅くなっちゃった……

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Ah, Sono-chan. Good work out there! Iroha's fine, she was playing with Onii-chan♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
苑ちゃん。
お疲れさまー！
いろはは大丈夫だよ、
おにーちゃんと遊んでたから♪

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Huh? Who's that?! Hey, Iroha, how many times have I told you to ignore strangers when they talk to you...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ、
誰！？
ちょっといろは、
知らない人に声かけられても無視しなさい
って
いつも言ってるでしょ……？

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Wrong! It's Iroha who called out to him!
text_block_list.orig_text:
違うよ！　
声かけたのは
いろはの方だよ！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...! Ah, I'm sorry, this kid's... Wait. You're...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……っ！
あ
ー
すみません、
うちの子が……
って。
君は……

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's this? Onii-chan and Sono-chan... you know each other?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふえっ？
なになに、
おにーちゃんって苑ちゃんの知り合いだったの？

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Amazing, this is fate! Hey, hey, what kind of relationship do you two have? When and where did you meet?
text_block_list.orig_text:
すごーい、
運命だよこれ！
ねえねえ、
二人はどういう関係？　
いつどこで会ったの？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Why are you so excited? He's just an acquaintance of mine.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いやなんでそんな興奮してんの。
ただの顔見知りってだけだよ。

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: An acquaintance, you say? Hmm, I see... Ehhh~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
顔見知り？
ふーん、
そっかー……
へぇ～～～～♪

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: More importantly, Iroha, it's getting late, so we're going home. As for you... you were playing with her too, weren't you? Thanks.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それよりいろは、
もう遅いし帰るよ。
君も……
いろはと遊んでくれてたんだね。
ありがと。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: The way home is the same for the both of us, right? I'll walk you home just in case, so come back together with us.
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうせ帰り道、
同じでしょ？
一応送ってってあげるから、
一緒に帰ろ。

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Today, you know? We all played both tag and rope jumping, you know? We also ran, played with a ball, and I even did the horizontal bar...
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日はね、
みんなで鬼ごっこして、
あと縄跳びでしょ、
かけっこでしょ、
ボール遊びに
鉄棒も……

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Some of our friends left halfway through, so we didn't have enough people, so we asked this passing Onii-chan to join us. Thanks to him, we had a lot of fun. Thanks again!
text_block_list.orig_text:
途中でお友だちが帰っちゃって、
人数足りなくなっちゃったから、
通りすがりのおにーちゃんに入ってもらったんだ～
おかげでいっぱい遊べたよ。
ありがとーね！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Yet this is the first time you two met, huh? I'm surprised you went along with her.
text_block_list.orig_text:
完全に初対面だったんかい。
君もよくそれで付き合ってくれたね。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Well, if you say so. But don’t go throwing your "nice guy" aura around too much, alright? It doesn’t always end well.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ならいいけど。
お人よしオーラを振りまくのも
ほどほどにしときなよ？
いいことばかりじゃないんだから。

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, hey. Onii-chan, where did you and Sono-chan meet? Are you really just acquaintances?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ねぇねぇ。
おにーちゃんと苑ちゃん、
いつ
どこで知り合ったの？
ホントにただの顔見知り？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Why are you so curious about that? I went to the library for work once, and he returned something I dropped.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんでそんなこと気にするかね。
前に仕事で図書館行った時に、
私の落とし物を届けてくれたんだよ。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Then, one thing led to another, and he ended up helping me with work... Yeah, that’s really all there is to it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それで
なんやかんやあって、
仕事を手伝ってもらって……
うん、
ホントそれだけだから。

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Hmm, hmm, I see...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふむふむ、
なるほどねぇ～……

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Hey, Uncle. Where's your house? Are you a student? What school do you go to?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねぇ
おじちゃん。
おじちゃん家ってどの辺り？
学生さん？　
どこの学校に行ってるの？

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: I mean, Uncle... You're "that" for her, right? You’re Sono-chan’s "special someone", aren’t you?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だっておじちゃん……
アレでしょ？
苑ちゃんの、
「いい人」
ってやつ！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Huh? Geez, this girl... where did you even learn those terms?
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ？
ったく
この子は、
どこでそういうのを覚えてくるんだか……

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: You don't have to be all shy~♪ Iroha's the type to understand these kinds of situations~
text_block_list.orig_text:
照れなくてもいいんだよ～♪
いろはって
そういうの、
わかっちゃうタイプだからさ～

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Come on, let's all hold hands. Iroha'll get between you two.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほら、
ちゃんとみんなで手を繋ごっ。
いろはが間に入ってあげるね。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Oi, Iroha, don't go and get all excited on your own. Hey, sorry for making you go along with this crazy girl's antics.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こらいろは、
勝手に盛り上がるなって。
ごめんね、
こんな変な子に付き合わせちゃって。

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Crazy girl she says, how mean. Iroha's working hard for your sake here, you know. I mean, you said it yourself...
text_block_list.orig_text:
変な子だなんてひどいなー、
せっかくイロハが頑張ってあげてるのに。
だって言うじゃん、
「子はかすがい」
って。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: That's just meddling, not helping. Don't say that with a smug look on your face.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それはもう、
かすがいじゃなくてお節介でしょ。
ドヤ顔で言うことじゃないっての。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: {0}-kun, if you don't like being teased, just say so. This girl's just playing around.
text_block_list.orig_text:
君もさ、
からかわれるのが嫌なら
ちゃんと言ってね。
この子は
あれだよ、
面白がってるだけだから。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Well, yeah... That's right. She's my precious niece, after all.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そりゃまぁ、
うん……
そうだね。
こんなんでも
私にとっては、
大事な姪っ子だからさ。

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Hoho~? I knew it, the two of you really create a nice atmosphere together♪ Iroha's like a third wheel here, how rude of her...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほほ～？　
やっぱりお二人、
いい雰囲気ですなぁ♪
いろははお邪魔虫のようなので、
これにて失敬……！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Heeeey, I won't let you get away. It's dangerous for you to start running out of the blue.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こーら、
逃がさないよ。
いきなり走り出したら危ないでしょ。

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Oh dear, guess it’s still too early for just the two of you, huh? Well then, Iroha will keep watch until you both can be honest with yourselves!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらら、
さすがに二人きりはまだ早いかぁ。
仕方ない、
二人が素直になれるまで
いろはが見守っててあげるね！

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Yes, thank you for your hard work!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい、
お疲れさまー

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: You can say that again. Iroha-chan in her child form was beyond the level of a mischievous elementary school kid...
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや本当にね。
子ども姿のイロハちゃん、
わんぱく小学生
ってレベルを超えてたわ……

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Thanks to that event, she seems to have grown quite attached to you. Personally, I think it'd be a good idea to entertain her antics.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おかげですっかり懐かれちゃったみたいだし。
でも、
あの子の遊びに付き合ってあげるのもいいんじゃないかしら。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: As you probably guessed, she's somewhat of a gifted child. But even so, she's growing up cheerful, energetic, and honest.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんたも察してるだろうけど、
いろいろ複雑な子なのよね。
それでも明るく元気に、
まっすぐ育ってくれてる。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: I'm in a position where I watch all sorts of young girls, but... when I look at her, I can’t help seeing her through a parent’s eyes.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あたしもいろんな子を見守ってる立場だけど、
ほら……
彼女を見てると、
自然と親みたいな目線になっちゃうのよね。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: So you too should face her properly. So that she can continue to grow up pure and honest.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だからあんたも、
ちゃんと向き合ってあげるのよ。
あの子がこのまま、
純粋にまっすぐ育っていけるようにね。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Well, since it's you, I'm sure I didn't need to tell you that. Keep up the good work, "Kind Uncle"♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、
あんたなら言われなくても大丈夫だろうけど。
これからも頑張ってね、
優しいおじちゃん♪

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Wait, was Iroha asleep?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うーん……
あれ、
もしかしてイロハ寝てた？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Not just you, Iroha, us too. See, thanks to that, the effects of the body swap elixir have been undone. Too bad, can't drink ale like this...
text_block_list.orig_text:
イロハだけじゃなくて、
私たちもね。
ほら、
おかげで入れ替わりの効き目も解けちゃったわ。
残念、
麦しゅわならず……

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: You're right, I'm back to my adult body! What should I do? I can't go into that hole like this~
text_block_list.orig_text:
ホントだ、
大人に戻ってる！
どうしよう、
これじゃ穴に入れないよ～

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Hah, that's right! Now that it's come to this, I just have to dig into that hole and make it bigger! Heheh, Iroha's such a genius!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はっ、
そうだ！　
こうなったら、穴を掘って
大きくしちゃえばいいんだ！
へへーん、
イロハったら天才！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: No, that's fine and all, but... Where does that passion even come from?
text_block_list.orig_text:
いやそれでいいんかい。
その情熱はどこからやってくるのさ。

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Well, yeah! Let's go, Uncle! With your help, even tough holes will be a piece of cake♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
まぁね！　
それじゃ、行こうおじちゃんっ。
おじちゃんも手伝ってくれたら、
手ごわい穴だってラクショーだよ♪

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Now that it's come to this, why don't we turn it into a hole big enough for just the two of us to fit in? Ehehe, I'm getting fired up!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こうなったらいっそ、
二人で入れるくらいおっきい穴にしちゃおっか？
えへへ、
燃えてきたーっ！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Safe travels. Make sure to get back before it get dark!
text_block_list.orig_text:
行ってらっしゃい。
暗くなる前に帰ってくるんだよー
